title: 热点的账单：用六个核心，诊断过去一年的热搜与争论 / The Bill of the Hot List: Six Lenses on a Year of Hot Debates
description:
中文. 本著作是系列的方法演示：用六个核心，把过去一年被反复讨论的公共事件做成一张张诊断卡。

核心主张：看懂一个热点，不是站对一边，而是看清它让出了什么。六把尺子（看见、记住、跟上、选择、讲述、临界）不问“谁对”，只问“卡在哪一层”。

结构与证据：19 章、113 页、8 幅图、72 张诊断卡（26 张数据主卡 + 3 张补卡 + 34 张主题卡 + 5 张长卡 + 4 张法国专章卡），另加 30 条一句话诊断；全部来自真实公开存档（338 天、2875 个话题；X 趋势 81 个“国家—日”采样），另设季度复盘、方法自检、十个反例与 90 分钟工作坊。

本版修订（2026-10-25）。修掉“六核/五核”不一致：英文副标题 Five Lenses→Six Lenses；前言“五本学术专著/五个更基础的动作”改为“六本/六个”，补上“临界”一条；第一章“五个问题”改为“六个问题”；诊断卡图与封面母题补上“临界”（原图只有五个镜头）；“怎么用这本书”从“三章、12+3 张卡”改为“十九章、26+3 张卡”，并补上复盘、自检、长卡、法国章入口；6034 个直引号改为中文引号；系列页更新为九本书并加入《心灵的分岔》；修正《选择的代价》DOI（23388629→23388628）。

诚实的纪律：每张卡标证据等级与可反驳条件；数据缺口与口径问题逐条写明；明确诊断的是讨论的结构，不是事件的对错。

边界：案例会过期，方法不会；它不预测、不判决，也不替代一手来源。涉及具体案件、数字与当事人的判断，以权威一手来源为准。

版本：2026-10-25，113 页，19 章，8 图，72 张卡；采集与统计脚本开源，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：九本书（六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本 + 一本科普专著《心灵的分岔》）与九篇工作论文。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/hotspot-bills。首选预览文件：hotspot-bills-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This is the series' methodological demonstration: six cores turn a year of contested public events into diagnostic cards. Core thesis: understanding a hot topic is not about taking the right side but about seeing what it gives up; six lenses ask not “who is right” but “on which layer is the argument stuck”. Structure and evidence: 19 chapters, 113 pages, 8 figures, 72 diagnostic cards (26 data cards + 3 supplementary cards + 34 thematic cards + 5 long-form + 4 France cards), plus 30 one-line diagnoses drawn from real public archives — 338 days and 2,875 topics from Zhihu, plus 81 country–day samples of X trends — together with a quarterly review, a method self-audit, ten counterexamples and a 90-minute workshop. Discipline: every card carries an evidence grade and a refutation condition; data gaps and measurement caveats are stated; the object of diagnosis is the structure of the argument, not the facts of the case. Boundaries: cases expire, the method does not; it neither predicts nor judges, and never replaces primary sources. Edition: 2026-10-25, 113 pages, 19 chapters, 8 figures, 72 cards.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-25). Fixed the six-core/five-core inconsistency: the English subtitle changed from “Five Lenses” to “Six Lenses”; the preface changed “five monographs / five more basic moves” to “six / six” and added the “criticality” bullet; Chapter 1 changed “five questions” to “six questions”; the diagnostic-card figure and the cover motif now include “criticality” (the old figure had only five lenses); “How to use this book” changed from “three chapters, 12+3 cards” to “nineteen chapters, 26+3 cards” and now points to the review, self-audit, long-form and France chapters; 6,034 straight quotation marks converted to Chinese quotation marks; the series page updated to nine books and now includes The Forking Mind; the DOI of The Price of Choice corrected (23388629→23388628).
notes: 科目（中文）：科学普及 Popular Science、复杂系统 Complex Systems、媒介研究 Media Studies、科学方法论 Scientific Methodology、社会观察 Social Commentary。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：19 章，113 页，8 图，72 张卡。首选预览文件：hotspot-bills-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。 系列共 19 件（18 件作品 + 本合集）；related_identifiers 已按裸 DOI 归一。
